test_title: PYST 59: RRB Group D - Mathematics (Held On: 23 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: A can complete a piece of work in 24 days, B in 18 days and C in 36 days. All of them started working together. After working for 4 days, A left the work. B and C continued, but B left 3 days before the completion of the work. How long (in days) did the work last?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

LCM = 72 ⇒ A = 3, B = 4, C = 2 units/day

First 4 days work = (3 + 4 + 2) × 4 = 36 units

Remaining = 72 − 36 = 36 units

Let total days = x ⇒ Last 3 days only C works

⇒ Work: (B + C)(x − 7) + C × 3 = 36

⇒ 6(x − 7) + 6 = 36 ⇒ 6x − 42 + 6 = 36 ⇒ 6x = 72 ⇒ x = 12

**∴ Answer = 12**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

A = 24 days, B = 18 days, C = 36 days

**Formula used:**

Work = Rate × Time

**Calculation:**

⇒ Take total work = LCM(24,18,36) = 72 units

⇒ A's efficiency = 72 ÷ 24 = 3 units/day

⇒ B's efficiency = 72 ÷ 18 = 4 units/day

⇒ C's efficiency = 72 ÷ 36 = 2 units/day

⇒ In first 4 days, all work together:

⇒ Work done = (3 + 4 + 2) × 4 = 9 × 4 = 36 units

⇒ Remaining work = 72 − 36 = 36 units

⇒ Let total time = x days

⇒ After A leaves, remaining time = x − 4

⇒ B leaves 3 days before end ⇒ B works for (x − 7) days

⇒ C works for (x − 4) days

⇒ Work by B and C:

⇒ B's work = 4(x − 7)

⇒ C's work = 2(x − 4)

⇒ Total work equation:

⇒ 4(x − 7) + 2(x − 4) = 36

⇒ 4x − 28 + 2x − 8 = 36

⇒ 6x − 36 = 36

⇒ 6x = 72

⇒ x = 12

**∴ The correct answer is 12.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Efficiency Concept

Efficiency = Total Work ÷ Time. Higher efficiency means faster work rate.

LCM Method

Take total work as LCM of individual times to simplify calculations.

Work Distribution

Total work = Sum of (Efficiency × Time) for each worker.
